name: no-income-tax
description: Use this skill for Norwegian personal income tax for income year 2026 (the calendar year, filed in 2027). It covers who is taxed in Norway, the 22% tax on ordinary income (18.5% in Finnmark and seven Nord-Troms municipalities), the five-step bracket tax (trinnskatt) on personal income, the national insurance contribution as it sits on the same base, the NOK 114,540 personal allowance, the 46% and 40% minimum deductions, the pension tax credit, the low-income limitation, the selected-youth work deduction, sole proprietors (enkeltpersonforetak) and calculated personal income, depreciation, wealth tax, returns, advance tax, enforcement fines and additional tax. Trigger on: Norwegian tax, skattemelding, trinnskatt, alminnelig inntekt, personinntekt, personfradrag, minstefradrag, enkeltpersonforetak, ENK, formuesskatt, forskuddsskatt, restskatt. Out of scope: no-social-contributions (contribution detail), no-employer-payroll, no-capital-gains (shares, shareholder model), no-individual-resid
